invariants.rationale: Parallelism usually represents degree of parallel execution and is expected to be positive.
The input data list should be non-null for mapping.
A function to map over data must be provided.
The level of parallelism should not typically exceed the number of data elements for efficient processing (with zero data, any parallelism is okay).
If the data list is non-empty, it may be required that all elements are non-null before applying the mapping function.
